(ix) Debt status, changes in credit rating and cash arrangement for repayment of convertible bonds in the next years

#### (x) Difficulties in business operation and solutions

During the reporting period, the Company encountered the following problems and difficulties in business:

1. The CPI index kept higher. The government kept issuing macroeconomic regulating approaches by raising the standby deposit ratio and the interests of deposit and loan, making commercial banks face constant credit risk, marketing risk interest rate risk and foreign exchange risk.

2. The surging capital market impacted the expansion of banking business. Especially, the source of liability business was affected to some degree.

3. China opened up RMB business to foreign-invested banks, bringing China's RMB business market fiercer competition. Depending on their outstanding sales team, advanced risk management skills and global operation resources, foreign-invested banks competed for quality customers in China. Chinese banks are facing bigger market challenges. The pace of interest rate liberality is getting fast.

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_2333_215_2390_383.jpg" alt="Image" width="2%" /></div>


Aiming to the above problems, the Company focused on the following work:

1. Actively optimized capital supply system. Enhance the ability of resisting risks. According to the needs of business development, the Company started the application for issuing subordinated bonds and the preparation for the issuance and successfully issued RMB 550 million yuan of subordinated bonds. The overall strength and risk-resisting ability was improved significantly. The Company started preparing for IPO. Following the principle of introducing in both capital and intelligent brains, the Company contacted and kept in touch with strategic investors from a number of countries.

2. Carried out the requirements on macroeconomic regulation and reinforced the control over total loan size. Under the premise of enhancing internal control and safe operation, The Company implemented various examination suggestions of the regulatory authorities, took corrective actions actively and strengthened the monitoring, preventive and controlling system. The internal control management system was further optimized. The Company established the Compliance Department to enhance the management over compliance risk and legal risk. Meanwhile, the Company changed the version and upgraded ISO 9000 Quality Management and Internal Control System. By further standardizing management and business process, the Company effectively controlled and lowered operating risks and improved internal management.

3. Improved internal management level and built an effective and complete internal management system. The Company carried out various examination opinions of the regulatory authorities, took corrective actions actively and strengthened the monitoring, preventive and controlling system. The internal control management system was further optimized. The Company established the Conformity Department to enhance the management over conformity risk and legal risk. Meanwhile, the Company changed the version and upgraded ISO9000 Quality Management and Internal Control System. By further standardizing management and business process, the Company effectively controlled and lowered operating risks and improved internal management level.

4. Made more efforts in product innovation and opened market space. In consideration of the contribution level of customers, the Company focused on the consolidation, development and growth of quality customer group. Based on structure adjustment, the Company promoted the steady growth and the development of the capital business of small and middle enterprises. The Company kept innovating in bankcard, entrusted wealth management and intermediary business to develop quality products. By reinforcing the combined marketing of various businesses, the Company reinforced the branding of Golden Deer Bankcard.

5. Enhanced resource allocation function and highlighted key points and strategic orientation. The Company further optimized banking office distribution, accelerated the pace of establishing cross-regional branches, invested more in financial equipment and system network construction, made more efforts in personnel introduction, development and reserve, and optimized compensation management system. In business operation, the Company reinforced economic capital management and supervision over expense conformity, lowed operating cost, and focused on key industries, key regions and key businesses.

##### Outlook and Approaches

The year 2008 is an important period of challenges and opportunities after the opening up of China's financial industry. It is also a key period for the Company to transform from strategic adjustment to strategic advancing. The Company is not only faced with opportunities brought by the positive macroeconomic development and the improvement of regional financial environment, but also the challenges triggered by fiercer competitions and increasing financial risks.

From the point of business environment, the economy keeps fast development; the financial system reform keeps deepening; personal income is increasing and spending idea changing; and social assurance system reform is accelerating. All of these provide powerful supports to the Company's thorough business management transformation, expanding business scale, improving overall strength and core competitiveness. Meanwhile, the pace of the interest rate and foreign exchange rate liberality is accelerating. The fast development of capital market generates a multi-level financial market. The policy environment of the supervision over capital market is relatively flexible. The opening up of the banking industry creates a good environment for international cooperation and import of overseas capital. Cross-regional operation expands both market and business. All this will provide much space for the Company's financial innovation, development of new businesses, cross-regional development and increase of income from intermediary business.



From the point of other banks, with the opening up of the financial industry, the competition is getting severe. The first is that the business management ability of foreign-invested banks is superior. They have many years of experience in investment bank business and intermediary business. The competition for high-end customers in the financial area is inevitable. The second is that the reform of state-owned big banks is accelerating. Their scale-based strength is enhanced. Depending on flexible system and production innovation, small and middle joint-stock commercial banks are taking more market shares. The third is that by reform and restructuring, city commercial banks become more vigorous. The cross-regional operation of some city commercial banks is progressing smoothly. The similar market positioning of city commercial banks, especially the competition in personal business and small business market, brings fiercer competition in terms of capital and human resource in the regional financial industry.

The development of the Company is also faced with the uncertain influences of many market environmental changes. The structural problem of economic development still exists. The macroeconomic regulation gets tighter. The role of the bank as a medium in financing is weakening. The accelerating interest rate liberality reduces the profitability of commercial banks. The small-scale operation hinders business innovation of city commercial banks. All of these are severe tests on the adjustment of the Company's business structure and customer structure and the credit risk management level. These factors bring challenges to the traditional interest-difference-based income mode of the Company and pressures to the market risk management and pricing ability of the Company.

Facing the opportunities and challenges brought by social and economic development, the Company will adapt itself to the new environment after the opening up of the financial industry. The Company will follow the standards of listed banks, be an outstanding retail bank, adjust structure and optimize service to build a modern commercial bank that has adequate capital, strict internal control, safe operation, normative service, high market strength and core competitiveness and is complied with international standards. The first is to broaden marketing ideas, optimize deposit structure and enlarge deposit scale. The second is to keep friendly cooperation with other banks, deepen customer structure adjustment, and make more efforts in expanding personal general credit authorization and small business loan. The third is to build a comprehensive risk management organizational structure, optimize risk management system and improve risk resistant ability. The fourth is to strengthen independent innovation idea and play a leading role of technology to improve core competitiveness. The fifth is to reinforce compliance management and improve process and quality standard awareness to build a long-term internal control mechanism. The sixth is to optimize organization setup and keep building cross-regional operational structure. The seventh is to enhance HR management, create scientific personnel utilization and incentive system and further improve the overall competence of the personnel. The eight is to emphasize company culture construction to improve the brand image of the Company.

## (xiii) Non-performing loans and the approaches to resolve non-performing loans

As of the end of the reporting period, the balance of non-performing loans of the Company was RMB 127,720,000 yuan, decreasing RMB 83.46 million yuan compared with that at the beginning of the year. The Non-performing loan ratio was 0.75%, decreasing 0.74% compared with that at the beginning of the year. In 2007, in order to manage and control non-performing loans effectively, the approaches adopted by the Company mainly included:

1. Actively responding to the macroeconomic regulation, tightening loan approval and withdrawing from precautious loan deals. The first was to tighten loan approval to control the loan quality from the beginning. The second was to withdraw with loan deals that had potential risks, further optimize credit and loan assets structure and improve the quality of credit and loan assets.

2. Reinforcing normative operation management and carrying out three examinations on loans. To reinforce the examination of risks of new loans, the Company formulated credit and loan business rules and regulations such as the Operation Process of Loan Investigation, Examination and Approval and the Notice of Standardizing Mortgage Business Operation, amended the Operation Process of Post-loan Examination and set up a specialized post-loan management center.

3. Optimizing the internal control system and the incentive system and treating rule-violating activities more strictly. The first was to review and assess the responsibilities of risky loans to resolve credit and loan risks. The second was to organize specialized operating risk examination around the bank, take corrective actions and investigate responsibilities. The third was to optimize the assessment and incentive system and increase the cost of violating rules.

4. Creating a multi-dimensional organization system and making more efforts in collecting and disposing non-performing loans. The first was to specify the key points of loan collection to collect non-performing loans effectively. The second was to make clear work division and make use of the two-level collection system. According to the Rules on Lawsuit Management of Bank of Wenzhou, the Company actively instructed sub-branches to make loan collection and disposal plans. The third was to collect and dispose non-performing loans of loss in a centralized way. According to the Rules on Centralized Management of Non-Performing Loans of Bank of Wenzhou, non-performing loans meeting the criteria are centralized to the headquarters. The Special Assets Department of the Headquarters would organize a professional team to collect and dispose the loans.

Notes: (1) Bank acceptance bill is a credit loan business in which the payee or payer (or cashing applicant) issues a commercial acceptance bill and the cashing applicant applies to the Bank and the Bank agrees to cash the commercial acceptance bill after examination.

(2) L/C is a credit loan in which the Bank is requested and instructed by the applicant to issue a written guarantee letter of certain amount which guarantees to pay the amount in a given period at a given place upon given documents.

(3) L/G is a credit loan business in which the Bank is requested by the applicant or authorizer to issue a letter of guarantee promising to the beneficiary that when the applicant fails to fulfill the liabilities and undertakings set in the contract, the Bank will cover the debt or bear the liabilities as ruled in the letter of guarantee.

## 2. Off-balance-sheet risk management

During the reporting period, the Company included off-balance-sheet credit authorization into the centralized credit approval management scope and controlled and prevented its risks in line with the rules on general credit and loan management. The Company set the controlling percentages for total off-balance-sheet open and acceptance bill open to the total loan balance. The Company also limited the total size of the acceptance bill open and the balance of face value.

#### (xvi) Risks and Countermeasures of the Company

## 1. Credit Risk Management

As a commercial bank, the Company faced credit risk, liquidity risk, market risk and operating risk. Recognizing these risks fully, the Company made efforts in improving risk management ability. The Company established an effective risk management system and prudent risk management culture, kept optimizing the risk management organizational structure and the policies and process for risk management. By using advanced risk measurement and management tools, the Company tried to realize growth while keeping high assets quality and increase risk-controlled returns. In 2007, no risks with material influences on the business operation of the Company occurred.

In risk management, according to the external financial environment, the Company adjusted credit and loan policy, adjusted credit and loan structure, focused more on advantaged industries, withdrew loans from high-risk industries and actively developed small and middle business customers that complied with the credit and loan requirements of the Company. The industrial structure, regional distribution and industrial combination of the credit and loan business were further optimized. Meanwhile, the Company controlled and resolved credit risk by improving credit authorization mode, establishing post-loan management center, reinforcing post-loan management, optimizing the five-degree loan categorization, promoting the 12-degree corporate loans, and strengthening early risk warning.

Loan application and loan investigation: Generally, the Company starts loan application process by talking to loan applicants face to face. Account managers finish pre-loan investigation report by analyzing the application documents provided by the applicants, visiting the site and referring to the rating results of the customer rating system.



Credit and loan approval: Credit and loan applications are approved by the branches, sub-branches or the Headquarters according to the credit and loan approval authority limit. Each approving authority is responsible for the management of loan size and the deposit/loan ratio in its authority scope. According to the principles of balancing safety and liquidity, profitability, they manage loan issuing targets, decide interest rate, judge investigation and examination opinions objectively and make decision, supervise the investigators and examiners on laws, rules and credit policy conformity and correct the mistakes of the investigators and examiners.

Loan issuance: The fund release centers of branches, sub-branches or the Headquarters handle the procedures for issuing loans. The fund release departments should check related documents to confirm that the loan is approved validly and the loan documents are complete.

### Post-loan management

(1) Supervision of the direction of credit and loan capital. According to the basic information known by the account manager of the Company and the agreed purpose of the loan contract, the account manager searches about the direction of the credit and loan capital, fill in the name of the payee, date, amount and purpose and checks the loan purpose with that in the contract to ensure the actual use of the loan is in accordance with the loan purpose in the contract. By examining if the borrower uses the loan as that set in the contract, repays the principal and interest on time or if the borrower has the ability to repay the principal and interest, the account manager can find out if the financing background of the borrower is true, if the borrower has any credit awareness, capital operating ability and business management ability problems and potential risks and if there are any credit and solvency problems in fulfilling the contract so that the Company can take actions to prevent the occurrence of risks in time.

(2) Post-loan examination and reporting system. The post-loan examination of the Company includes off-site examination and on-site examination, in which, off-site examination mainly examines various entries according to the financial statements provided by the enterprise to analyze the financial status, cash flow and solvency of the enterprise. The borrower is required to provide monthly financial statements and analyze financial status quarterly at least. On-site examination may be regular or irregular. Regular on-site examination is to learn the production and business status of the borrower and ensure the materials and stock, mortgage (pledge), equipment and facilities of the borrower are in good condition. Irregular on-site examination is carried out when the account balance and financials statements of the borrower is abnormal or shows other early warning signals. The account manager is required to take at least one on-site examination quarterly and record the examination results. If the account manager finds some major affairs of the borrower that may impact big influence on the loan of the Company, he should report to the upper management in time. At present, the written records of the post-loan examination are all reminded by the post-loan management system. The branches and the sub-branches review the written records on the system according to the post-loan examination authority limit of the Company.

(3) Loan categorization according to the solvency of the borrower (including the loan repayment record, the will of repaying the loan, and guarantee status). The branches and the sub-branches and branches of the Company are responsible for collecting, examine and verify loan categorization information and report to the Risk Management Department of the Headquarters. At present, the Company implements a five-degree categorization system, adjusts monthly, categorizes quarterly and reports to regulatory authorities. To corporate customers, based

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_2332_214_2391_382.jpg" alt="Image" width="2%" /></div>


on the five-degree categorization, the Company also implements a 12-degree categorization system internally to categorize each degree more specifically. The categorization results are more accurate and reasonable.

(4) Management and collection of non-performing loans. The non-performing loans of the Company refer to the inferior loans and below in the five-degree categorization system. The Company manages loans of loss in a centralized way. The branches and sub-branches report loans of loss to the Headquarters and facilitate the Special Assets Management Department in collecting and disposing non-performing loans. The Special Assets Management Department is responsible for examining the files of non-performing loans under centralized management, takeover of non-performing loans and daily management of loan collection and disposal after the non-performing loans are gathered together. The Accounting Center is responsible for checking the accounts upon gathering the non-performing loans, transferring the accounts to the upper-level department, daily bookkeeping and verifying the accounts with the fact after the non-performing loans are gathered together. To non-performing loans occur in the year, the Company deducts assessment profit of the branch or sub-branch of the year in advance. To non-performing loans kept in the branch or sub-branch, the Company assigns loan collection targets to the branches and sub-branches to urge them pay more effects in loan collection.

## 2. Liquidity Risk Management

Liquidity risk refers to the risk unable to timely cash the assets at a reasonable price in order to provide fund for due debts. The liquidity risks of the Company mainly result from activities providing funds such as loans, transactions and investment as well as management over current assets. The main purpose of the liquidity risk management of the Company is to ensure the liquidity in market cycle and financial crisis so as to satisfy the Company's payment obligation and unknown demand and provide capital for the Company's loan business and investing opportunities.

The Asset and Liability Management Committee is the decision-making body taking charge of the liquidity management of the Company. It formulates the policies for liquidity risk management. The Planning and Financial Department under the Asset and Liability Management Committee is responsible for daily liquidity risk management, monitors and analyzes the liquidity of the Company on a regular basis and makes decisions on liquidity risk management within its authority.

By internal capital transferring system, the Company manages liquidity of the bank in a centralized manner. In the aspect of assets, the Company keeps a proper percentage bill discount asset and high liquid short-term assets such as deposits in other banks, repurchase agreement and investment in central bank bills to ensure adequate liquidity of assets. In the aspect of liabilities, the Company raises money from various channels including the public market of the central bank, inter-bank monetary market and bill market of the financial industry to ensure financing channels unblocked and daily liquidity demand satisfied. The Company sets various percentage standards (including but not limited to deposit/loan ratio, standby deposit ratio and setting up in structive ratio goal for every branches and sub-branches) and limit to transaction amount according to the overall asset and liability status in order to monitor and manage liquidity risk. The Company has also established the early warning system for liquidity risk and the liquidity management system to monitor the fund balance of each branch or sub-branch every day in order to keep safe liquidity.

The Table of Liquidity Gap indicates that in 2007, the Company has a negative liquidity gap of RMB -725 million yuan. The liquidity gap ratio was -6.71%, complying with the regulatory requirement of -10%. The liquidity gap of real time repayment was RMB -8.08 billion yuan. Deposits mature in three months accounted for 72.24% of the customers' deposits, in which demand deposit accounted for 40.68% of the customers' deposit while loans of over three months accounted for 75.01% of the loans to customers. The terms of the assets and liabilities of the Company basically matched. Therefore, the liquidity risk of real-time repayment is actually small.



## 3. Market Risk Management

Market risk refers to the risk of loss on the on-balance-sheet and off-balance sheet transactions of the bank due to negative changes in market price (interest rate, foreign exchange rate, stock price and commodity price). The market risk of the Company mainly includes interest rate risk and foreign exchange risk. The Risk Management Committee of the Company is responsible for market risk management of the entire bank, gives opinions and advice to the Board on the approval of the strategies and policies for the market risk management and in deciding the market risk level the Company can bear, urges the management team to take necessary actions to identify, measure, monitor and control market risks, acquires regular reports on market risk type and level, monitors and assesses the completeness and effectiveness of market risk management and diligence of the management team in market risk management.

The market risk measurement methods of the Company include but not limited to VAR, gap analysis, mark to market, duration analysis, sensitivity analysis, pressure test and post hoc test. The company has established regular market risk analysis reporting system and provisional major event reporting system to inform the management team about the latest market risk status of the management team.

## 4. Interest Rate Risk Management

Interest rate risk refers to the risk of negative influence on the financial status of the Company due to the fluctuation of the market interest rate. The interest rate risk of the Company is mainly caused by the incompliance of the terms of asset and liability transactions and the influence on the equity of the Company from the fluctuation of market interest rate. The short-term goal of risk management of the Company is to keep the steady growth of net interest income. The long-term goal is to steadily increase the equity of the Company.

## 5. Foreign Exchange Risk Management

The foreign exchange risk of the Company is mainly derived from foreign currency open position. In consideration of the universal phenomenon of short-term deposit and long-term loan, the high appreciation of RMB and customers' increasing will of selling foreign currencies, to avoid such risks, the Company has carried out balanced management over assets and liabilities in line with reasonable, long-term and prudential principles. According to the fluctuation of market foreign exchange rate, the Company actively adjusted the structure assets and liabilities in foreign currencies to lower the risk of open position.

## 6. Operating Risk Management

Operating risk refers to the risk of loss caused by imperfect or problematic internal process, staff and IT system and external affairs. The Company keeps improving the operating risk management structure, system platform and technology means to further improve the operating risk management level. Within the total risk management frame, the Company makes clear definition, classification of operating risks of the Company and the environment construction for the operation mechanism of the operating risk management. Catching the opportunity of building the internal control system and based on specialized case handling, the Company actively organizes and carries out risk management examination, assess the operating risk status of the Company objectively and develops operating risk management culture. Meanwhile, the Company improves operating risk-controlling ability by improving the IT system. In 2007, the Company mainly took the following actions:

(1) carrying out the reform on organizational management structure and risk management system and establishing the Compliance Department at the Headquarters to take charge of conformity management.

(2)updating and revising the version of ISO 9000 Quality Management System and sorting all business

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_2333_214_2393_382.jpg" alt="Image" width="2%" /></div>


management rules and regulations since the founding of the Bank; according to the requirements on "process bank", identifying and assessing the risks in each process of every business to ensure all risk points can be controlled effectively; and amending related rules and regulations according to the business development status.

(3) Developing the operating risk monitoring and examination system; supported by information technology, reinforcing long-distance monitoring over branches and solving the problems such as examining cost, quality and efficiency.

(4) carrying out specialized case handling, business bribery control and comprehensive social order improvement programs to do self-examination and take corrective actions; further carrying out operating and management responsibility system and punishing employees' rule-violating activities more strictly.

(5) Keeping carrying out the internal control assessment system, linking the internal control assessment results with the performance assessment of branches and sub-branches more closely, promoting the construction of compliance-based culture, and creating a good environment that conformity creates value and everyone observes rules.

(6) In IT aspect, the Company set up computer information disaster backup system in the same city and carried out same-city disaster recovery drills. The applicability and disaster-resisting ability of the system was improved. The Company assessed the security condition of various systems, formulated emergency plans for all application systems, optimized the process for handling emergencies, reinforced the monitoring over the operation of the production system, and established hot backup and cold backup for key equipment, which effectively improved system security. The Company further optimized computer development and operation management system, carried out self-examination of info-system security and security level protection, specified the security level And protective approaches for various application systems, deployed or developed intrusion detecting system, vulnerability scanning system, safe log-in management of the host computer, teller fingerprint ID verification, early warning system for over-the-counter risks and centralized operation monitoring system, improving the security of the IT system.

(8) Starting with enhancing the management of over-the-counter operation. By position rotation of chief accountants, improving the management and assessment means of the chief accountant designation system, setting up authorization center, implementing teller fingerprint verification system and developing anti-money laundry assistant system, the Company strengthens internal control and prevents operating risks.

##### (xvii) Notes to Completeness, Reasonableness and Validity of Internal Control

(7) Through constant legal education and internal control and compliance education, employees at various levels from the Headquarters, branches and sub-branches are given specialized education on laws, professional ethics, internal control and compliance to improve their awareness of internal control and compliance and risk prevention and set up the idea of doing business in line with laws and regulations.

According to the Company Act, Commercial Bank Act, Guidance for Internal Control of Commercial Banks, Guidance for Corporate Governance of Joint–Stock Commercial Banks and integrating the advanced management modes of domestic and overseas commercial banks, the Company optimized the internal organization structure and has established a corporate governance frame consisting of Shareholders' Meeting, Board of Directors, Supervisory Board and the top management and realized the operating system that ownership, operating right and supervising right are separated and inter-restrictive. Meanwhile, the Company has established controlling systems for authorization and approval, power and responsibility separation, credit and accounting loan risk control, system control, information system control and assets in kind control, which are all carried out effectively. The Company has passed ISO 9000 Quality Management System certification. The Headquarters designates chief accountants to branches and sub-branches, rates internal control of the branches and sub-branches and sets up capital release center. The Internal Audit Department constantly monitors business activities and assesses transactions individually, and submits written reports to the management team. The report discloses the defects of internal control and gives suggestions on improvement. The Company recognizes, measures and records valid economic transactions pursuant to rules and regulations. The advanced computer software and internal network system provide technology support for reflecting various kinds of business information timely and correctly. The financial report of 2007 properly disclosed the financial status, business outcomes and cash flow of the year. Smooth communications between the management and the internal departments and external departments are ensured, including communications with related interested parties, regulatory departments and CPAs. The chief accountant designation system of the Company can ensure branch and sub-branches institutions recording various transactions timely, correctly and completely according to finance policy. According to the audit of Lixin CPAs, the external audit institution of the Company, no material defects concerning the completeness, reasonableness and validity of the internal control system of the Company had been found.



## III. Use of Raised Fund in the Reporting Period and the Results

During the reporting period, the Company issued RMB 550 million of subordinated bonds, which has entered supplementary capital according to the regulatory rules.

## IV. Changes of Business Environment and Macroeconomic Policy and Their Influences

### (i) Macroeconomic regulation

In 2007, targeting the problems such as overheating fixed asset investment, over-fast increase in monetary loan, increased foreign trade surplus, and CPI highly exceeding the warning point, the regulatory authority released tightening policies frequently, including raising the benchmark interest rate six times, raising the statutory standby deposit rate ten times, increasing public market operation, issuing targeted bills and window guidance. In addition, the government also reinforced the implementation of combined policies, including issuing special government bonds, restarting special deposit, imposing more custom duty on some products, adjusting export tax refund and issuing new rules on foreign exchange.

Facing the increasing macroeconomic regulations, the Company controlled loan issuance reasonably, kept steady and balanced loan growth, further adjusted asset structure, ensured and restricted loan issuance properly, optimized loan structure, increased types of consumer loan, and expanded consumer loan business. Meanwhile, the Company made efforts to secure intermediary agent business and wealth management business to look for new profit generators. Generally, the macroeconomic regulation accelerated the Company's asset structure and income structure adjustment and did not impose material negative influence to the Company.

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_2334_214_2393_383.jpg" alt="Image" width="2%" /></div>


#### (ii) Deposit and loan interest rate adjustment

March 18, 2007, the People's Bank of China raised deposit and loan benchmark interest of financial institutions. The one-year deposit benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 2.52% to 2.79%. The one-year loan benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 6.12% to 6.39%. Other deposit and loan interest rates were also adjusted accordingly.

May 19, 2007, the People's Bank of China raised deposit and loan benchmark interest of financial institutions. The one-year deposit benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 2.79% to 3.06%. The one-year loan benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.18% from 6.39% to 6.57%. Other deposit and loan interest rates were also adjusted accordingly.

July 21, 2007, the People’s Bank of China raised deposit and loan benchmark interest of financial institutions. The one-year deposit benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 3.06% to 3.33%. The one-year loan benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 6.57% to 6.84%. Other deposit and loan interest rates were also adjusted accordingly.

August 22, 2007, the People’s Bank of China raised deposit and loan benchmark interest of financial institutions. The one-year deposit benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 3.33% to 3.60%. The one-year loan benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.18% from 6.84% to 7.02%. Other deposit and loan interest rates were also adjusted accordingly.

September 15, 2007, the People’s Bank of China raised deposit and loan benchmark interest of financial institutions. The one-year deposit benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 3.60% to 3.87%. The one-year loan benchmark interest rate of financial institutions raised 0.27% from 7.02% to 7.29%. Other deposit and loan interest rates were also adjusted accordingly.

To the increase of deposit and loan interest rate, the Company prepared for it timely and completely. On the one hand, it reinforced asset and liability management, optimized asset structure and increased income from loan business. On the other hand, it effectively prevented interest rate risk. As the interest rate got higher gradually, the Company shortened investment duration. In general, the six times of deposit and loan interest rate increase were close to the capital price on the market and improved the business performance of the Company. In the future, the Company will keep tracing, analyzing and studying interest rate risk and emphasize asset and liability management.

### (iii) Capital market

In 2007, China's capital market kept booming. The index of Shanghai A shares increased near 100% over the year. The booming capital market changed the Company's liability structure. Some saving deposits flowed to other financial institutions. Meanwhile, fixed deposit accounted for higher proportion in the self-run deposit of the Company, which increased capital cost. On the other hand, intermediary business related to the capital market developed to some degree, which optimized income structure and improved business performance.

### (iv) Statutory standby deposit rate

The People's Bank of China raised statutory standby deposit rate ten times on January 15, February 25, April 16, May 15, June 5, August 15, September 25, October 25, November 26 and December 25 respectively from 9% to 14.5%, increasing 5.5% in total. The main purpose was to reinforce macroeconomic regulation and liquidity management, restrict the over-fast growth of total monetary loan and maintain good economic development trend.



The constant increase of statutory standby deposit rate reduced available fund of the bank and brought up new challenges to the liquidity management of the bank. It required the management team to tighten liquidity management and keep adequate liquidity and profitability. As the Company had adequate fund source and unblocked financing channels, the increase of statutory standby deposit had limited influence on the liquidity of the Company and did not imposed material influence on the liquidity management of the Company. The Company adjusted the proportions of high–liquid assets such as investment, financing and bills and actively participated in bill market, monetary market and bond market to ensure liquidity and improve profitability.

### (v) Changes in foreign exchange

In 2007, the People’s Bank of China accelerated foreign exchange management system reform and further optimized the RMB foreign exchange formation mechanism. The basic role of market demand and supply became increasingly important. According to the middle rate of RMB/USD, 7.3046, on the last day of 2007, RMB increased 5041 basis points compared with 7.8087 at the end of the last year, increasing 6.4%. Compared with the exchange rate, 8.11, after the foreign exchange reform, RMB has increased 10% in total. Meanwhile, the exchange rate of RMB also showed two-way fluctuations. The exchange rate was increasingly flexible and daily fluctuations more widening.

The constant appreciation of RMB and the increasing exchange rate fluctuation imposed more exchange rate risk to the Company. To respond to the risks caused by exchange rate changes, the Company reinforced quantitative measurement and analysis of exchange rate risk while emphasizing the management over exchange rate open. According to the market exchange rate fluctuation, the Company adjusted asset liability structure in time.

### (vi) Changes in home loan policy

In 2007, China's real estate regulation policy was further specified and tightened. The People's Bank of China and China Banking Regulatory Commission released the Notice of Reinforcing Management over Loans to Commercialized Real Properties (YF [2007] No.359) and the Supplementary Notice Reinforcing Management over Loans to Commercialized Real Properties (YF [2007] No.452). These policies are positive to the healthy development of the real estate industry and regulate the property loan risks of commercial banks. According to the notice, to reinforce and improve property loan management, control property loan risks and promote constant and healthy development of the property loan business of the Company, the Company distributed the Notice on Further Reinforcing Management over Commercialized Property Loans and issued the Implementation Rules on Property Loans of Bank of Wenzhou to instruct the operation of property loan business. It is required to carry out related policies strictly. The examination and audit on real estate loan business were emphasized. Through the above approaches, the Company maintained high asset quality while keeping the property loan business developing healthily.

## (vi) Preliminary Profit Distribution Plan for 2007

The 20 $ ^{th} $ meeting of the 3 $ ^{rd} $ Board of the Bank on January 15, 2008 discussed and adopted the resolution to Share A IPO. The meeting resolved that the profit distribution plan for the undistributed profit of the Bank before IPO was: “If the Bank successfully issues Share A and goes to public, the undistributed profit before the IPO shall be shared by new and old shareholders.”

The meeting also resolved that in distributing the profit of 2007, provide 10% of the profit of 2007 audited by Lixin CPAs as statutory surplus reserve and 10% of the stock capital as dividend to shareholders. All remaining distributable profit is provided as general provision. In distributing the profit of 2007, if the amount of general provision does not reach 1% of the risk assets as of the end of 2007, then the general provision shall be provided fully by June 30, 2008. The above resolutions of the Board of Directors was discussed and adopted in the first extraordinary shareholders' meeting of 2008 on January 31, 2008.

According to the above resolutions, as of December 31, 2007, after providing 10% of the profit as statutory surplus reserve, the accumulated undistributed profit was RMB 295,506,590.88. Provide 10% of the stock capital, RMB 102,318,192.10 yuan, as dividend to shareholders. After providing for the dividend to shareholders, the remaining undistributed profit was RMB 193,188,398.78 yuan. As of December 31, 2007, the total risk assets of the Company were RMB 19,468,101,213 yuan. 1% of the balance of the risk assets was RMB 194,681,012.13 yuan. The amount of general provision provided should be RMB 193,188,398.78. After providing for general provision, the accumulated undistributed profit was RMB 0 yuan. A general provision of RMB 1,492,613.35 yuan should be provided from the after-tax profit of January to June 2008 by June 30, 2008.



## (vii) Business Development Plan for 2008

### (i) Guideline for business development of 2008

Follow the spirit of the 17th Congress of Chinese Communist Party and the economic work meeting of the central government, based on the “four excellence” bank and set listed banks as benchmark. Characterized by its outstanding retail, the bank creates brand name and opens market externally, reinforces management and improves quality internally, adjusts structure, optimizes services to get proper, harmonious and steady development. Develop the bank from a small one to a middle one, from a local bank to a regional bank, from a traditional bank to an innovative bank, and try to be a listed bank.

### (ii) Business target of 2008

– Various deposits increase RMB 2.8 billion yuan and daily deposit increases over RMB 2.7 billion yuan.

– Various loans increase RMB 2 billion yuan and daily deposit increases over RMB 1.9 billion yuan.

– Non-performing loan rate over the year decreases 0.11% over the year according to the five-degree categorization; the non-performing loan rate at the end of the year lower than 0.63%.

– Capital adequacy ratio over 8% and core capital adequacy ratio over 4%; cash dividend to shareholders accounts for 10%.

– to realize general profit RMB 562,410,000 yuan and before-tax profit RMB 523,300,000 yuan.

– to move IPO preparation forward, amend and optimize basic systems, and finish share trust.

– to adjust and expand branch institutions.

– to keep introducing in strategic investors.

#### (iii) Main approaches at work in 2008

1. Optimize the operation of the Shareholders' Meeting, the Board, the Supervisory Board and the top management. Strengthen the role of the Board and create complete and normative corporate governance system. The first is to further specify the responsibilities of the Shareholders' Meeting, the Board, the Supervisory Board and the top management based on the current corporate governance structure. Create smooth information communication system and effective restrictive relation among them, fully play the active role of each level, cooperate within the Company and promote fast development of the Company. The second is to carry out the ultimate responsibility of business management undertaken by the Board, play the instructive and supervising role of the specialized committees of the Board on important business decisions, risk management and compensation distribution, strengthen the credit and diligence of the Board, play the role of independent directors and fully make play the central role of the Board in corporate governance. The third is to reinforce the level-one corporate system, optimize the rank-by-rank authorization management system, promote vertical management and intensive operation, improve the transparency in information disclosure and social credit, formulate and optimize basic management rules such as the Articles of Incorporation and the Rules on Investor

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_2334_216_2393_383.jpg" alt="Image" width="2%" /></div>


Relation Management in advance according to the requirements on IPO, emphasize trainings for directors, carry out director assessment system, optimize the incentive and restrictive system for the management team, and strive to create an effective management and operation team.

2. Reinforce risk management system, promote the construction of process bank and create a complete and scientific internal control and compliance management system. The first is to set up the basic frame for compliance risk management, gradually establish a complete and effective risk prevention and controlling management system centering on the internal rating system and risk-adjusted return on capital and covering credit risk, market risk and operating risk. Set up Risk Control Committee under the Office of President, explore the way to establish independent approving official and further promote manager responsibility system for risks to improve internal control and compliance risk preventing ability. The second is to keep improving the organization system for internal control. The Board and related committees listen to business report and risk analysis and assessment report regularly to learn the status of internal control thoroughly, carry out all rules and regulations of internal control, reinforce risk management in all aspects, reinforce the enforcement and authority of the internal control rules, improve ISO 9000 Quality Certification System, create clear compliance risk reporting process and implement early warning system for major business activities to improve the overall internal control capability. The third is to explore the centralized asset operation and management system to safeguard assets, manage non-performing loans in a centralized and professional way, apply different policies to different types of accounts in loan collection, minimize the loss on assets and reduce the amount and rate of non-performing loan.

3. Improve organization structure and deploy resources effectively to establish a practical and steady operation system. The first is to catch the opportunity of renaming the Company, following the principle of close to the market and close to customers, establish Financial Service Department of Bank of Wenzhou, make use of the resource of the brand “Wenzhou”, create the characteristic service mode of merchants of Wenzhou, fully develop the resources of merchants of Wenzhou, closely cooperate with the financial institutions in the cities which have a big number of merchants of Wenzhou, and provide settlement, financing and wealth management services for merchants of Wenzhou together so as to lay a foundation for the Company’s cross-regional operation. The second is following the principles of expanding the radiating scope of the banking offices and optimizing the distribution of banking offices, re-locate the sub-branches in the city, set up branch and sub-branch institutions to counties where economy is developed and financial service offices are in lack to satisfy the Company’s demands of business development and customer service. Start up cross-provincial development strategy, cross-regional merger and restructuring strategy to promote the Company to grow from a local bank to a regional bank. The third is to reinforce HR management, formulate scientific HR management system with strategic view and systematic thinking, create and optimize HR recruitment, selection, use, training, containing and retaining systems to attract competent people who have high professional level and rich practical experience to join the Company so as to lay a foundation for positive business development in the Company.

4. Explore and carry out strategic management, improve the value of the Company, and create competitive core competence of the Company. The first is to advance capital-leading strategy. Use capital management idea in modern economics to guide capital management, set up risk weight system for different assets which is complied with business development characters of the Company, make capital growth estimation, improve capital utilization, improve capital coverage over risks, form risk capital restrictive and management system, and realize the maximum support from the capital size set by the regulatory authority to the business development of the Company. The second is to carry out multi-dimensional business strategies. Fully understand that it is an irresistible market trend for the role of the bank as a medium in financing is weakening.

Catch opportunities, take actions actively, transform business style early, develop new products of securities and insurance and try to gain the qualification for third-party deposit and fund dealership. Provide complete financial services including banking, securities and insurance to customers. design and develop credit investigation, business credit rating, asset rating and financial information consultation services to form competitiveness in new business areas to build a broader business platform. Try to operate intermediary businesses such as investment bank and financial adviser and gradually fit into the capital market. Strive to be an all-around customer value creator. The third is to explore differentiated business strategies. Based on the macroeconomic regulation policies and the development trend of the financial industry, actively and effectively work out the differentiated development strategies that are suitable for the business development of the Company and embody the strength in the market. Segment the market and function positioning, create and maintain competitive strengths and develop core competitiveness.

## II. Independent Opinions of the Supervisory Board on Related Matters

#### (i) Lawful Operation

During the reporting period, the Company run business and managed the Company lawfully in line with laws, regulations and the Articles of Incorporation of the Company. No directors and members of the top management of the Company was found activities breaching laws, regulations or the Articles of Incorporation or any activities that may impair the interests of the Company and its shareholders.

#### (ii) Authenticity of Financial Statements

The annual financial report of the Company has been audited by Lixin CPAs Co., Ltd. according to new accounting principle. Lixin CPAs prepared an unqualified auditors' report. The financial report indicated the financial status and business outcomes of the Company truly, objectively and correctly.

#### (iii) Use of Fund Raised

During the reporting period, upon the approval of the People's Bank of China and China Banking Regulatory Commission, the Company raised RMB 550 million yuan of subordinated fixed-term bonds, all of which was used to supply the supplementary capital of the Company, increase capital adequacy ratio and improve risk-resisting ability and overall strength. The Company used the raised fund legally and in line with regulations. No activities violating laws and regulations or damaging the interests of the Company and the shareholders have been found.

#### (iv) Acquisition and Sales of Assets of the Company

During the reporting period, the Company did not have any major acquisition or sales of assets.

#### (v) Transactions with Related Parties

During the reporting period, the transactions with related parties of the Company mainly involved with credit and loan business.

All credit and loan business with the related parties of the Company were handled pursuant to related laws, regulations and the loan conditions and approving process of the Company. No circumstances damaging the interests of the Company and the shareholders have been found.

#### (vii) Internal Control

During the reporting period, the Company formulated relatively reasonable and effective internal control system, which is complied with the reality of the Bank. The system plays an important role in regulating financial accounting behaviors, improving accounting information quality, enhancing business management, controlling operating risk, avoiding flaws and preventing malpractice. It guarantees the Bank's assets safe and integral, protects the rights and interests of interested parties related to the Bank, and improves the credit and market competitive strength of the Bank. Lixin CPAs Co., Ltd. audits the criteria on the notes to the effectiveness of the internal control of the Company set in line with the Guideline for Internal Control Audit. Lixin CPAs certified that the criteria on the notes to the effectiveness of the internal control set by the Company kept effective internal control related to the financial statement in all material aspects as of December 31, 2007.

#### (viii) Implementation of Resolutions of Shareholders' Meeting

The Supervisory Board of the Company supervised the implementation of the resolutions of the shareholders' meeting and believed the Board had carried out every resolution seriously, responsibly, timely and well. The Supervisory Board had no objection against all reports and proposals submitted by the Board to the Shareholders' Meeting for discussion.

## III. Transactions with Related Parties

#### Major transactions with related parties

Major transactions with related parties disclosed by the Company refer to a single transaction with a related party of the Company and the amount of the transaction is over 1% of the Company's equity, or after the Company finishes a transaction with a related party, the balance of the transaction with the related party accounts for over 5% of the Company's equity.

As of December 31, 2007, the Company's equity was RMB 1,867,797,400 yuan. The balance of transactions with Natural Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., Sanhu Concrete Group Co., Ltd. and other two related companies was RMB 393,950,000 yuan in total, accounting for 2.11% of the Company's equity, meeting the conditions for major transactions with related parties.

Note: As of the end of the reporting period, the transactions between the Company and the related parties were complied with laws and regulations, and the Company's rules on loan issuance and loan issuing industries. The guarantees were mainly real properties and all collaterals had been valued. For the over-mortgaged part, the Company required the loan being guaranteed by a qualified corporation or individual. No preferential condition was found in the transactions with related parties. The risk was controllable and the transaction behavior was proper and fair. The transactions with related parties did not impose negative effects on the business and profit of the Company.

#### Ordinary transactions with related parties

Ordinary transactions with related parties disclosed by the Company refer to a single transaction with a related party of the Company and the amount of the transaction is below 1% of the Company's equity, or after the Company finishes a transaction with a related party, the balance of the transaction with the related party

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="imgs/img_in_image_box_2334_214_2393_382.jpg" alt="Image" width="2%" /></div>


accounts for below 5% of the Company's equity.

As of the end of 2007, the Company had ordinary transactions with 197 related parties, generating loan balance of RMB 212,279,300 yuan, in which, mortgaged loans accounted for 98.63% of the total amount. The mortgage procedures were complied with laws and regulations, without any preferential condition to that of other borrowers. The risk was controllable and the transaction activities were proper and fair. The transactions were complied with the Company's rules on loan issuance and loan issuing directions.

#### All Related Level

As of the end of the reporting period, the Company's transactions with related parties were RMB 251,674,300 yuan in total, accounting for 13.47% of the equity at the end of 2007, which was complied with the requirements of the regulatory authority.

# 立信會計師事務所有限公司 Shu Lun Pan Certified Public Accountants Co., Ltd.

# Auditors' Report

XKSBZ (2008) No.20569

All Shareholders of Bank of Wenzhou Co., Ltd.:

We have audited the attached financial statements of Bank of Wenzhou Co., Ltd. (hereinafter the Bank), including the Balance Sheet as of December 31, 2007, the Profit Statement, the Statement on Changes in Shareholders' Equity and the Cash Flow Statement of 2007, and an notations of financial statement of 2007.

I. The responsibilities of the management for the financial statements

According to the Enterprise Accounting Principles, it is the responsibility of the management of the Bank to prepare these financial statements. The responsibilities include: (1) to design, carry out and maintain the internal control related to the preparation of the financial statements in order to ensure the financial statements free of material errors caused by fraud or mistakes; (2) to choose and adopt proper accounting policy; and (3) to make reasonable accounting estimates.

## II. Responsibilities of the CPAs

We take the responsibility to give our opinions based on the audit of the financial statements. We carried out the audit in accordance with the China CPAs Auditing Principles, which requires us to observe the professional ethics and rules in planning and carrying out the audit so as to obtain proper evidence indicating if there is any the material error in the financial statements.

Our audit involved in carrying out the audit procedures in order to obtain the evidence supporting the amounts and disclosures in the financial statements. The selection of the audit procedures depended on the judgment of the CPAs. The judgment included the evaluation on the risks of material errors in the financial statements caused by fraud or mistakes. During the risk evaluation, we considered the internal control related to the preparation of the financial statements so as to design proper audit procedures; however, the purpose was not to give our opinions on the effectiveness of the internal control. Our audit also included evaluating the rightness of the accounting policy and the rationality of the accounting estimates made by the management as well as evaluating the overall properness of the financial statements.

We believe that the audit evidence we obtained was complete and proper, which provided reasonable basis for the auditor's opinions.

## III. Auditors' Opinions

In our opinion, the financial statements of the Bank were complied with the requirements of Enterprise Accounting Principles and have fairly indicated the financial position as of December 31, 2007 and the business outcomes, cash flow and changes in owners' equity in 2007 of the Bank in all material aspects.
